content.doc: Healing is non-destructive. It resets all values to their defaults but never erases Archive entries. History is preserved. The healing protocol stabilizes all sprites, normalizes their velocities, restores full opacity, and resets Nucleus parameters. It creates an Archive entry to confirm the event. CanHeal is true as long as the module is not in finished state.
